newsitem.title: USA: Interstate Hotels to build Conn. hotel.
newsitem.headline: Interstate Hotels to build Conn. hotel.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Co said Wednesday it will, as part of a partnership agreement, build a Courtyard by Marriott in Orange, Conn.
Construction is slated to begin in November, with a target opening in September 1997, for the 121-room hotel.

The hotel will be fully owned by a partnership between the developer of the property and Interstate Hotels, Interstate said. The property, which is expected to cost about $9.3 million, will be managed by a division of Interstate, the company said.
An Interstate Hotels spokeswoman said that the company will hold at least 50 percent of the partnership.
